QC: UHN Tsao Lung PDX XevaSet

2026-09-30

Download required packages

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
if (!requireNamespace("Xeva", quietly = TRUE))
    BiocManager::install("Xeva", version = "3.20")

Load library

library(Xeva)
## Warning: package 'Xeva' was built under R version 4.4.3

Read Dataset

x.set <- readRDS("../expected_results/xevaset/UHN_Tsao_Lung_DrugResponse_2022_v1.rds")
getwd()
